name: The Parting of the Ways
oracle_text:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Exile the top five cards of your library. For each nonland card exiled this way, put a number of time counters on that card equal to its mana value. If it doesn't have suspend, it gains suspend.
II — Time travel, then time travel.
III — For each opponent, destroy up to one target artifact that player controls.
blocked_sentences: II — Time travel, then time travel.

needs.what: the keyword action time travel (701.55): for each permanent you control with a time counter on it and each suspended card you own in exile with a time counter on it, you may put a time counter on it or remove a time counter from it (a per-object add/remove/skip choice), repeatable as two sequential instances
needs.why_existing_wont_do: No time_travel op in reference; add_counters/remove_counters/proliferate each act in one fixed direction over a fixed selector and cannot offer a per-object add-or-remove choice spanning battlefield permanents and suspended cards in exile
